## Grimlock (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
 NE Medium monstrous humanoid  
 **Init**+1;**Senses** blindsight 40 ft., scent; Perception +9  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 15, touch 11, flat-footed 14 (+1 Dex, +4 natural)  
 **hp**22 (2d10+2)  
 **Fort** +1, **Ref** +4, **Will** +2  
 **Immune** gaze attacks, visual effects  
 **Weaknesses** blind  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** battleaxe +4 (1d8+3/x3)  
 

**Statistics**

 **Feats** Alertness, Skill Focus (Perception)

 **Languages** Grimlock, Undercommon  
 


**Ecology**

 
**Environment** underground  
 **Organization** gang (2-4), pack (10-20), tribe (10-60 plus 1 leader of 3rd-5th level per 10 adults), war party (60-100 plus 1 leader of 3rd-5th level per 10 adults plus 1 medusa leader or 1 leader of 6th-8th level).
